test_stimuli.name: all_pins_high
test_stimuli.derivation: Port byte 0xFF: bit0=1 => p0=1, bit1=1 => p1=1, bit2=1 => p2=1, bit3=1 => p3=1, bit4=1 => p4=1, bit5=1 => p5=1, bit6=1 => p6=1, bit7=1 => p7=1; INT is open-drain output, read as 1 when not asserted.

test_stimuli.name: all_pins_low
test_stimuli.derivation: Port byte 0x00: all bits 0 => all channels 0.
